fields.name: legalName
fields.label: Company name
fields.description: Full legal name, including 'Ltd'.

fields.name: phoneDisplay
fields.label: Phone number (as shown on the site)
fields.description: How the number appears to visitors, e.g. 07777 39 25 38.

fields.name: phoneDial
fields.label: Phone number (for the Call button)
fields.description: What the Call button actually dials. Keep the +44 form with no spaces, e.g. +447777392538.

fields.name: whatsapp
fields.label: WhatsApp number
fields.description: International form: starts 44, no plus sign and no spaces, e.g. 447777392538.

fields.name: whatsappMessage
fields.label: WhatsApp opening message
fields.description: The message pre-typed for someone when they tap WhatsApp.

fields.name: accessHours
fields.label: Access hours
fields.description: e.g. Mon–Sat 7am–7pm. Only appears when the toggle below is on.

fields.name: accessHoursConfirmed
fields.label: Show access hours on the site
fields.description: Leave off until the hours above are final. Off shows 'access on request' instead.

fields.name: companyNumber
fields.label: Company registration number
fields.description: From Companies House. Leave blank to hide it.

fields.name: minimumTerm
fields.label: Minimum term note
fields.description: Shown under the price table, e.g. 'One week minimum, no long tie-in'. Leave blank for 'No long tie-in'.

fields.name: pricesIndicative
fields.label: Show 'prices are indicative' note
fields.description: Turn this off once your prices are final and firm.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: e.g. 20ft container

fields.name: priceFrom
fields.label: Price from (£)
fields.description: Just the number, e.g. 35. Leave blank to show the note below instead.

fields.name: priceUnit
fields.label: Per
fields.description: The unit after the price, e.g. week.

fields.name: priceNote
fields.label: Text to show when there's no price
fields.description: Used only when 'Price from' is blank, e.g. 'Call for availability'.

fields.name: whatFits
fields.label: Roughly what fits
fields.description: The short description in the middle column of the table.

fields.name: available
fields.label: Show this row
fields.description: Turn off to hide this row from the table without deleting it.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order in the table
fields.description: Lower numbers appear first (20ft = 1, 40ft = 2, yard = 3).

fields.name: image
fields.label: Background photo
fields.description: The large photo behind the headline at the very top of the home page.

fields.name: src
fields.label: Photo
fields.description: Tap to choose an existing photo or upload a new one. Any size or shape is fine — the site resizes and optimises it for you. No need to crop or shrink it first.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Photo description
fields.description: A few words describing what's in the photo, e.g. 'The gated yard entrance'. Used by screen readers and search engines. Not shown on the page.

fields.name: objectPosition
fields.label: Focus point (advanced — usually leave as is)
fields.description: Which part of the photo to keep in view if it has to be trimmed to fit the slot. '50% 50%' is the centre. Use '50% 0%' to favour the top, '50% 100%' for the bottom. Leave as '50% 50%' if unsure.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Headline
fields.description: The big headline over the photo. Best kept under about 55 characters, or it can wrap awkwardly on phones.

fields.name: leadBefore
fields.label: Sentence before the price
fields.description: The line that leads up to the '£xx a week' price. The price is filled in automatically from your 20ft price, so you don't type it here. Keep a space at the end.

fields.name: leadAfter
fields.label: Words after the price
fields.description: The words that come straight after the price, e.g. ' a week.'

fields.name: facts
fields.label: Security cards (first three)
fields.description: The first three cards. The fourth card, ‘Easy access’, fills itself in from the access-hours setting in Business details, so it isn't listed here.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Card title
fields.description: Keep it short — one to three words.

fields.name: finding
fields.label: ‘Finding us’ section
fields.description: The address and map fill themselves in from Business details — you only edit the directions and the areas line here.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Page headline
fields.description: Best kept under about 55 characters.

fields.name: leadBefore
fields.label: Intro sentence before the price
fields.description: Leads up to the '£xx a week' price, which is added automatically. Keep a space at the end.

fields.name: leadAfter
fields.label: Words after the price
fields.description: e.g. ' a week.'

fields.label: Paragraphs
fields.description: The main text, one box per paragraph. Use the + button to add a paragraph, or the handle to reorder them.
